summary: Cadeler plc (UK) filed a 6-K announcing completion of its share exchange offer to holders of Cadeler A/S (Denmark) in connection with the group's redomiciliation from Denmark to the UK, with first trading of Cadeler Shares on NYSE and Oslo Børs on 5 November 2026. Each Cadeler A/S share exchanged for one Cadeler share; roughly 7.94% did not tender, lifting tendering holders' relative stake by 8.62%. Because Cadeler holds over 90%, it will launch a Danish statutory squeeze-out at NOK 58.42 cash per share, funded by a DNB Bank facility; watch delisting and residual-holder timing.
